name: Frankie Drake Mysteries
description: Toronto’s only female private detective in the 1920s takes on the cases the police don’t want or can’t handle. From airplanes and booze running to American G-men, Communists and union busters, Frankie’s fearless sense of adventure gets her into all kinds of trouble, but she always manages to find her way out.

videos.title: A Frankie Drake Mysteries Cold Case: Episode 1
videos.overview: Frankie gets word her father could be involved with a cold case from 1905 conducted by Brackenreid and Watts.

videos.title: A Frankie Drake Mysteries Cold Case: Episode 2
videos.overview: Frankie is skeptical that Hudson could be her father while Brackenreid and Watts interrogate their potential suspect.

videos.title: A Frankie Drake Mysteries Cold Case: Episode 3
videos.overview: Brackenreid and Watts continue their investigation and Frankie hits the road.

videos.title: A Frankie Drake Mysteries Cold Case: Episode 4
videos.overview: Brackenreid and Watts look for Frankie to get answers about her father.

videos.title: A Frankie Drake Mysteries Cold Case: Episode 5
videos.overview: Mary’s investigation leads to answers while also landing her in hot water.

videos.title: A Frankie Drake Mysteries Cold Case: Episode 6
videos.overview: Frankie, Brackenreid and Watts track down Mary, but can they figure out the secret of Frankie’s father?

videos.title: Mother of Pearl
videos.overview: Frankie is forced to partner with an unlikely ally when she’s the number one suspect in a jewellery heist.

videos.title: Ladies in Red
videos.overview: Frankie and Trudy are hired by a factory owner to root out communists at his plant, but things soon take an explosive turn.

videos.title: Summer in the City
videos.overview: When a body turns up in the luggage of a young man, Frankie and Trudy must join forces with reporter Ernest Hemingway to clear his name.

videos.title: Healing Hands
videos.overview: When Trudy gives shelter to a faith-healing preacher’s daughter, she and Frankie find themselves investigating Toronto’s Jazz scene.

videos.title: Out of Focus
videos.overview: Frankie and Trudy go undercover in the glamorous world of film in order to solve a seemingly impossible murder on a silent movie set.

videos.title: Whisper Sisters
videos.overview: After a shooting injures the young son of a friend, Frankie and Trudy’s investigation leads them into the dangerous world of bootlegging.

videos.title: Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Mary recruits Frankie and Trudy to find a missing teacher, but their investigation leads them to family secrets, Chinatown and murder.

videos.title: The Pilot
videos.overview: A day off turns into a day at the office for Frankie and Trudie when the infant son of a charismatic aviator is kidnapped during an air show.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: The horrors of war haunt Frankie when the investigation of a soldier's murder reunites her with a friend left traumatized by his tour of duty.

videos.title: Anastasia
videos.overview: Frankie is hired to confirm the identity of a young woman claiming to be a Russian princess and protect her from those who want her dead.

videos.title: Once Burnt Twice Spied
videos.overview: When Frankie gets a mysterious call from a British spy, Mary discovers how she and Trudy met and how Drake Private Detectives was formed.

videos.title: The Old Switcheroo
videos.overview: An old rival turns up selling antiques but Frankie's convinced it's a scam. The team tries to prove it before she takes the money and runs.

videos.title: Last Dance
videos.overview: The team investigates a kidnapping gone wrong at the Palais Royale. They learn that the victim is gravely ill and race to find him and save his life.

videos.title: Radio Daze
videos.overview: Mary is acting in a radio drama, but when she realizes the play is a cover for a heist, she must find a way to warn Frankie.

videos.title: Emancipation Day
videos.overview: Donations are stolen from a coloured girls' orphanage and civil rights her Marcus Garvey hires the team to catch the thief and find the cash.

videos.title: Dressed to Kill
videos.overview: Famed French designer Coco Chanel is the target of a brazen assassination attempt and Drake Private Detectives are hired to protect her.

videos.title: Extra Innings
videos.overview: Frankie investigates the mid game death of a baseball player.

videos.title: 50 Shades of Greyson
videos.overview: Mary’s job is threatened when she accuses Detective Greyson of hiding evidence.

videos.title: Diamonds are a Gal’s Best Friend
videos.overview: What starts as a simple case of a missing horse leads the team into the gardens of Toronto’s elite in pursuit of a murderous jewel thief.

videos.title: Dealer's Choice
videos.overview: Frankie and Trudy reluctantly take a case from mob boss Bessie Starkman, but things take a turn when Frankie's accused of murdering a mole.

videos.title: Now You See Her
videos.overview: When a magician's assistant is killed, Frankie goes undercover to find the culprit. But can she see clearly through the smoke and mirrors?

videos.title: No Friends Like Old Friends
videos.overview: After her wartime friend goes missing in London, Frankie must work with Agatha Christie to uncover the reason behind the disappearance.

videos.title: Counterpunch
videos.overview: Frankie steps into the boxing ring to stop illegal boxing and meets up with her old friend Moses Page.

videos.title: School Ties…School Lies
videos.overview: To find the killer of a beloved teacher at a swanky private school, Frankie enlists the help of a precocious student.

videos.title: A Brother in Arms
videos.overview: Frankie's floored when a man claiming to be her half-brother shows up at the agency begging her to help his wrongly imprisoned friend.

videos.title: Things Better Left Dead
videos.overview: Frankie concocts a chilling ruse to expose a man who claims he can speak to the dead.

videos.title: Life on the Line
videos.overview: When a toy store owner is the target of a harassment campaign, the gang goes under cover at a telephone exchange to nab the culprit.

videos.title: Out on a Limb
videos.overview: When a showgirl dies, Frankie's investigation leads her to go under cover as a server at a mermaid-themed nightclub.

videos.title: Ward of the Roses
videos.overview: The detectives investigate a fire-bombing at the campaign office of a female politician.

videos.title: A History of Violins
videos.overview: When a priceless violin is stolen, the Drake Detective Agency tracks down the culprit.

videos.title: A Sunshine State of Mind
videos.overview: Frankie and team must outcon a conman who's stolen money from Nora and Mildred.

videos.title: Scavenger Hunt
videos.overview: A scavenger hunt our gals are on turns deadly - is it a case of killing off the competition or more personal?

videos.title: Prince in Exile
videos.overview: When a playboy prince is kidnapped, the team has to be discreet as they investigate so to avoid an international incident.

videos.title: The Girls Can't Help It
videos.overview: Frankie and Trudy investigate a trio of flappers as they search for a stolen, priceless bottle of wine.

videos.title: A Most Foiled Assault
videos.overview: Fierce competition and sexism stymie the gal's murder investigation at a female fencing trial.

videos.title: Ghost in the Machine
videos.overview: Nora is convinced she was visited by the ghost of a murdered woman; she makes Frankie and Trudy search their building. This leads to a shocking discovery.

videos.title: The Guilty Party
videos.overview: The team investigate whether a man acquitted of a grisly murder is indeed innocent or guilty.

videos.title: Life is a Cabaret
videos.overview: Witnessing a man's murder; Frankie's search for his lady-friend suspect leads her to an underground cabaret.

videos.title: Sweet Justice
videos.overview: When Trudy discovers that her new dream home has contaminated water, the gals investigate the source with help from nighttime vigilante, Lady Justice.

videos.title: Showstoppers
videos.overview: Mary looks into a morality violation by Rita Hart's modern dance troupe. Frankie questions if they've brought the Spanish Flu to Toronto.

videos.title: A Family Affair
videos.overview: A shakeup in all the gals' lives affects sees Frankie's dad alive but in danger, Trudy leave the DPD, Mary going on the record, and Flo's new family threatened.
